compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Only 59 of the 221 bug tickets filed 7–21 Aug 2026 carry a `caused_by` link, and the most-linked target (`hemophobic-vegetarian-mynah`, 8 links) is a misattribution — its "children" are unrelated CI items. The link is the only machine-readable causation in the store; without it the fortnight review had to re-derive introducing commits by `git log -S` for 196 bugs, and agent-written "pre-existing"/"regression" labels were wrong 43 times. Story `major-specified-bream` measures whether `caused_by` can be auto-derived; this story makes the link trustworthy when written by hand. Approved 2026-08-21.

## Approach
(1) Validation at link time in `src/rebar/_lib_writes.py` (`link`) and the MCP/CLI surfaces: a `caused_by` target must be a ticket that has at least one trailer commit reachable from `origin/main` (resolved via the existing referencing-commit scan in `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py`), else the link is refused with a message naming the rule; `--force=<reason>` keeps the escape hatch. (2) A janitor/fsck check that, for each `caused_by`, the target's earliest trailer commit is not newer than the bug's introducing construct where the bug records an `introducing_sha` (new optional field on bug tickets, written by rebar-debug Step 0/Phase 1). (3) Seed: the review's dated set (196 rows, sha + date + method + confidence) is attached to this ticket as the labelled corpus for `major-specified-bream`.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_lib_writes.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/link.py` (or wherever `link` is implemented), `src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py`, `src/rebar/schemas/ticket_state.schema.json` (optional `introducing_sha`), `src/rebar/_commands/fsck.py`, `docs/ticket-model.md`, `tests/unit/commands/test_caused_by_validation.py` (new).

## Testing
Happy path: `link <bug> <ticket-with-commit> caused_by` succeeds. Edge: target with no trailer commit is refused; `--force` with reason succeeds and records the reason; fsck flags a `caused_by` whose target commit postdates the recorded `introducing_sha`. Pinning: `tests/interfaces/test_write_parity_oracle.py` (the link row), `tests/unit/test_fsck*.py` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A `caused_by` link to a commit-less ticket is refused on CLI, library and MCP with the same message; checked by the parity oracle row.
- [ ] `rebar fsck` reports a `caused_by` whose target commit is newer than the bug's `introducing_sha`; checked by a fixture store.
- [ ] The dated corpus is attached to this ticket as a comment or artifact; checked by `rebar show`.
compiled_state.title: Make caused_by trustworthy: validate the target has a commit, fsck-check it against the bug's introducing sha
